baits.name: Breadcrumbs
baits.desc: Free, endless, and frankly beneath most fish.

baits.name: Sandworm
baits.desc: Wriggles convincingly. Eels cannot leave it alone.

baits.name: Brine Shrimp
baits.desc: Pink, salty, and gone the moment it touches deep water.

baits.name: Glowgrub
baits.desc: A grub that glows. The things that hunt by their own light come to see whose it is.

baits.name: Marsh Worm
baits.blurb: Fen bottom feeders: tench, pike, eels
baits.desc: Dug from under the reeds. It is the colour of the mud and nearly as cheerful.

baits.name: Glass Mayfly
baits.blurb: Fen fish that feed at the top: glassfin, gar
baits.desc: Lives a day. Mara packs them by the dozen and does not say how she keeps them.
